remarks: Large three bedroom two bathroom condo located in desirable Eastside Commons complex. Hardwood floors in main living areas. Newer stainless steel appliances, private balcony. Three good size bedrooms, primary with ensuite and goodsize walk in closet. Washer/drier in unit. Spacious closets in the other bedrooms. Lobby with concierge, lounge, fitness center. Private courtyard with bbq area. Shuttle service to train. Complex is walking distances to shops, restaurants and downtown entertainment. easy access to I.95 and close to all transportation.  Unit will be professionally cleaned before occupancy. Must have excellent credit.
